data.one_liner: Flutter charts built on community_charts with support for bar, line, scatter, combo, and pie charts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of widgets for rendering various chart types including bar, line, scatter, combo, and pie charts with options for customization like gradients and axes.
use_when: You need to display bar, line, pie, or scatter charts in your Flutter app.
You want a wrapper around community_charts with simplified options.
avoid_when: You require advanced charting types not covered by community_charts.
You want to avoid depending on community_charts_flutter2.
strengths: Supports multiple chart types like bar, line, scatter, combo, and pie.
Includes gradient and styling configuration options.
weaknesses: Built on top of a community fork of charts, which might have future maintenance considerations.
Limited documentation outside of the provided example links.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: More widely used and actively maintained native charting library for Flutter.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Comprehensive enterprise-grade charting suite with extensive chart types and features.
